mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.title AS post_title, p.content AS post_content, m.name AS membername, MAX(u.avatar) AS avatar, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.name) AS tag_title, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pi.image_url) AS image_urls, p.create_time AS post_time, p.user_id AS user_id, MAX(ua.create_time) AS favorite_time FROM user_action ua LEFT JOIN post p ON ua.post_id = p.id LEFT JOIN member m ON p.user_id = m.id LEFT JOIN user_profile u ON p.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN post_tag pt ON p.id = pt.post_id LEFT JOIN tag t ON pt.tag_id = t.id LEFT JOIN post_image pi ON p.id = pi.post_id WHERE ua.user_id = #{userId} AND ua.action_type = 'favorite' AND p.status = '1' GROUP BY p.id, p.title, p.content, m.name, p.create_time, p.user_id ORDER BY favorite_time DESC;
